mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract_account ( linked_account_id, account_status, selected_at, ended_at, contract_id ) VALUES ( #{account.linkedAccountId}, #{account.accountStatus}, #{account.selectedAt}, #{account.endedAt}, #{account.contractId} )
mapper.select: SELECT contract_id FROM loan_contract WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE contract_account SET account_status = #{status}, ended_at = NOW() WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT contract_account_id AS contractAccountId, linked_account_id AS linkedAccountId, account_status AS accountStatus, selected_at AS selectedAt, ended_at AS endedAt, contract_id AS contractId FROM contract_account WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY selected_at DESC, contract_account_id DESC LIMIT 1
